rationale: The base station had only 6 of 8 devices bound, so capacity was not the issue. Logs showed pairing windows expiring with "no join request received," and the customer was pairing from far away (downstairs sofa) while only pressing the button once instead of holding SYNC for 3 seconds. Once the sensor was brought within 1 metre and the SYNC button held for 3 seconds, it paired immediately.

repair_steps: Bring the sensor within 1 metre of the base station.
Open the app and start Add Device (pairing mode).
Hold the SYNC button on the sensor for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue continuously.
Keep the sensor close until the app confirms pairing.

results.text: HB-100 owner could not add a new door sensor; app showed E-201. Base station already had 8 devices. Customer removed an old test sensor and pairing succeeded. Resolved at frontline.

Put the base station into pairing mode from the app (Add Device). Then hold the SYNC button on the camera or sensor for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue. Keep the peripheral within 1 metre of the base station during pairing. Pairing times out after 120 seconds. After pairing, the device can be moved to its final location.

Solid blue: online and connected to cloud. Blinking blue: pairing mode (lasts 120 seconds). Solid red: no internet uplink. Blinking red: booting or firmware update in progress, do not unplug. Solid purple: storage almost full (over 95 percent).
